ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota Immigration Crackdown
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti and the subsequent investigation into the Minnesota immigration crackdown.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential corruption
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
Is there evidence of corruption or misconduct within the Trump administration?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and corruption within the Trump administration. By following the money and investigating potential corruption, we may be able to shed light on the motivations behind the immigration crackdown and the subsequent investigation.
